title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00085 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:30 - 01:00: Completed pre-skid checks. Prepared to skid cantilever
01:00 - 01:15: Performed TBT for skidding cantilever
01:15 - 02:00: Skidded cantilever to f-15 d.
02:00 - 03:30: Removed hatch on f-15. Installed halfmoon hatch. Checked alignment.
03:30 - 04:00: Installed hi-pressure riser and m/u connector on WH.
04:00 - 06:15: Built scaffolding in moonpool.
06:15 - 07:00: Moved BOP to well center. Landed same on HP riser.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT for n/u BOP with ongoing crew
07:15 - 09:00: N/u BOP. Meanwhile prepared tension cylinders. Installed tension cylinders.
09:00 - 09:30: Installed slipjoint.
09:30 - 10:00: Installed diverter
10:00 - 10:45: M/u slipjoint to BOP. Meanwhile filled well from trip tank. R/d chains and installed BX elevator and rotator.
10:45 - 11:00: Performed TBT for connector test meanwhile lined up to cement unit.
11:00 - 11:30: Performed connector test to 20/115 bar for 5/10 min.
11:30 - 11:45: Performed TBT for p/u and RIH with RTTS RT
11:45 - 12:15: P/u and m/u the RTTS RT BHA. Checked and greased tool.
12:15 - 12:30: RIH w/ RTTS RT on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 130 m.
12:30 - 13:00: M/u TDS and pumped 150 LPM 5 bar. Recorded up/down weight 71/68 ton, set down 1 ton on RTTS rotate 22 turns. No pressure observed below RTTS.
13:00 - 13:15: Released RTTS packer. Waited 10 min for packer elements to retract. Observed trip tank slowly decreasing, then leveling out.
13:15 - 13:30: Flowchecked well, 90 ltr loss over 15 min.
13:30 - 14:00: POOH w/ RTTS packer on 5 1/2" DP from 130 m to surface.
14:00 - 14:30: L/d storm valve, RTTS RT and packer.
14:30 - 16:45: L/d 4 stands 8 1/4" DC, high torque needed to break connection, 130knm.
16:45 - 17:00: Cleaned and cleared drill floor. Meanwhile performed TBT for pressure testing oh to surface cement plug
17:00 - 17:45: Attempted to pressure test oh to surface cement plug to 115 bar, pressure bled off after reaching 10 bar. Static losses 1,2 m3/hr.
17:45 - 18:00: Performed

sections.text: Completed pre-skid checks. Prepared to skid cantilever
Performed TBT for skidding cantilever
Skidded cantilever to f-15 d.
Removed hatch on f-15. Installed halfmoon hatch. Checked alignment.
Installed hi-pressure riser and m/u connector on WH.
Built scaffolding in moonpool.
Moved BOP to well center. Landed same on HP riser.
Performed TBT for n/u BOP with ongoing crew
N/u BOP. Meanwhile prepared tension cylinders. Installed tension cylinders.
Installed slipjoint.
Installed diverter
M/u slipjoint to BOP. Meanwhile filled well from trip tank. R/d chains and installed BX elevator and rotator.
Performed TBT for connector test meanwhile lined up to cement unit.
Performed connector test to 20/115 bar for 5/10 min.
Performed TBT for p/u and RIH with RTTS RT
P/u and m/u the RTTS RT BHA. Checked and greased tool.
RIH w/ RTTS RT on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 130 m.
M/u TDS and pumped 150 LPM 5 bar. Recorded up/down weight 71/68 ton, set down 1 ton on RTTS rotate 22 turns. No pressure observed below RTTS.
Released RTTS packer. Waited 10 min for packer elements to retract. Observed trip tank slowly decreasing, then leveling out.
Flowchecked well, 90 ltr loss over 15 min.
POOH w/ RTTS packer on 5 1/2" DP from 130 m to surface.
L/d storm valve, RTTS RT and packer.
L/d 4 stands 8 1/4" DC, high torque needed to break connection, 130knm.
Cleaned and cleared drill floor. Meanwhile performed TBT for pressure testing oh to surface cement plug
Attempted to pressure test oh to surface cement plug to 115 bar, pressure bled off after reaching 10 bar. Static losses 1,2 m3/hr.
Performed TBT for cutting 13 3/8" casing.
P/u and m/u 13 3/8" cutter BHA.
RIH w/ 13 3/8" cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 53 m.
Installed PS-21 slips.
Continued RIH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 53 m to 694 m. Avg. Tripping speed 640 m/hr.

Established paramters. Up/down weight 92/87 ton. 400 LPM 34 bar, 500 LPM 57 bar, 600 LPM 76 bar. Positioned cutter at 700 mmd. Cut 13 3/8" casing, 600 LPM 57 bar, 80 RPM. Pressure dropped, good indication of cut. Observed h2s gas at shaker, 11 ppm h2s in air, 52ppm in gas trap.
Circulated 500 LPM 52 bar through mud/gas separator due to h2s. Circulated until h2s out of well, pumped totally 72 m3. Treated return pits with h2s scavenger.
POOH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 700 m to 453 m. Avg. Tripping speed 330 m/hr.
